checklist.notes: the model supports a two-event retell; the communicative goal and feedback references remain lesson-bound.
A model, partner role, delayed bounded feedback, turn cap, and explicit success/stop conditions create a usable roleplay cycle.
The protocol reuses a source-lesson utterance and declared scope rather than introducing an unrelated target.
Roles and completion logic are explicit in the protocol, though the learner-visible situation could be more concrete.
One question at a time and bounded output or feedback keep the interaction manageable for the declared tier.
Learner production, partner interaction, delayed feedback, and a six-turn cap are appropriate for speaking.
The short, structured self-study interaction is accessible to Vietnamese learners and avoids unsupported population-wide or accent claims.

findings.description: The learner-visible opening says ‘work toward the stated goal’ but does not itself state a concrete role, information gap, or first partner cue.
findings.recommendation: Expose a one-sentence scenario and immediate communicative task while retaining the scope and turn cap.

limitations: Static protocol wording only was reviewed. No live provider behavior, audio realization, learner response or outcome, provider authentication, human review, or release approval was observed or claimed.
